_comment: MS51 CONFIG bytes, written by mcct.py flash (nuvoispy -c). Chip options only;
every firmware option is in user_config.h.
lock: true makes the flash unreadable over ICP (a later flash mass-erases it). Set it for production.
WDT_enable: hardware watchdog as a reset timer that software cannot disable. The firmware
refuses to run without it (CFG_REQUIRE_HW_WATCHDOG). WDT_keep_active: false = it pauses
brownout: reset below 3.7 V (the ADC is referenced to VDD, so readings below that are
meaningless) and no flash writes while VDD is low.
OCD_enable: on-chip debugger off (its pins are the console).
